author: in2forex
text:
Hi Miserly_One

Thought I would comment on your chart. The first QM the one marked with green I think is a valid QM. The QM within the QM to me isn't great I see more of a Can Can as marked on the chart.

But here's a question for you, can you identify the other QM in the chart? Have a look and see if yo can see it.

author: Miserly_One
text:
Thanks In2forex! Greatly appreciate your input. As regards the nested QM, I see what you mean by it being more like a Can Can rather than a QM. Point gratefully taken!

You hinted to the presence of another QM - I think I see a bullish QM. Initially I was a little concerned about the huge number of bars between the HH and the revisit to the demand level. But I sense it does not really matter as long as the basic form of the pattern can be seen. Do let me know if my identification of the bullish QM is correct.
